title: FIFA & Football Manager, I'm coming for you…
author: Living-Inspection582
selftext:
Quick disclaimer: Why am I posting this? 100% because I hope someone will find this new game I made interesting and give it a shot. I'm also running some ads on Reddit, but I wanted to make a more personal post about the game.

And even though this game honestly couldn't have been made by me alone without the help of the evil AI, this message right here is not written with AI. It's written by the father of an 8-month-old boy, who, while his son is sleeping, tries everything he can to chase his dream of becoming a game developer.

SO. Let me introduce you to the game, and the thoughts behind it.

[BigClub.io](http://BigClub.io)

The game is a weird cocktail that my brain has mixed up from experiences with games I've played over maybe the past 15 years.

But the two biggest inspirations for the game are Hearthstone (which many of you probably already know) and the soccer/football game called "New Star Soccer", which I can't recommend enough. And then FIFA FUT, Football Manager, and basically all related manager-type games.

So what I wanted to make was a Football Manager game with the gameplay of Hearthstone, so a deck-building card game, but with football/soccer players.

One more disclaimer: I'm not sure whether I should call this football or soccer. For me it's football, since I'm from Europe. However, I have no clue how many Americans etc. there are here. Sorry for being weird.

Mixed with the card gameplay, I wanted incremental features from New Star Soccer, where you always grind and progress to become better. All set in a football/soccer world, with all the players you know, teams, etc.

However, since I'm pretty sure I'd get sued into eternity if I used the real player and team names, I've made "quirky" versions of them all:

Erling Goaland, Bukayo Saxophone, Bayern Munchies, Dortmuffin

…you get the point. So hopefully still relatable and familiar, while keeping me somewhat on the "right side".

The game has the incremental features from New Star Soccer: you can build your stadium, get sponsorships, sell shirts based on your popularity, hire coaches, etc. This gives you coins each day, which you can then use on the transfer market to buy new player cards, or on player packs you can open to hopefully get some rare players, etc.

The gameplay is pretty Hearthstone-ish. Each player has some stats. You can tackle, pass the ball to an attacker, and they can shoot on goal. Whether they score depends on their stats, the opponent's defense, etc.

You can play Secret Weapon cards like Yellow Card, Park The Bus, Red Card, Free Kick, Double Goal…

What I hope is that the game makes sense, and that when you read this, you already kind of get the point.

I also made it so you can bet your hard-earned coins on real matches from the five big football/soccer leagues. I'm unsure whether players are going to find this fun and whether it makes sense. But now I've made it, and I'll see how it goes. It was kind of to give the game a "meta layer" and bring some real-world elements into the game.

There's still so much the game needs before it's polished and better. But I can't do it without players reporting bugs, recommending changes, etc.

Luckily, I've very quickly gotten an amazing player base that sends me bugs, recommendations, etc. every single day. Which is just truly amazing.

If you've read this far: THANK YOU. I hope you'd like to give the game a try.

It's 100% free, and there are no ads. I earn nothing from this.

Is the goal to earn from it one day? Absolutely. I want to make a living from this. Which maybe is naive. But if I don't try, it's for sure never going to happen. And I'm really enjoying myself and having fun building this, so it's never going to be a waste.

No matter what, I can tell my son that his dad built a mediocre browser game that he earned nothing from, and that a few people tried.

How cool is that! Lol.
